name: Fintech Quadrature Expansion Inventory
summary: Provider refinements for Fourier and local-volatility integration contexts in option-pricing CDGs.

operations.name: Check Domain Coverage
operations.intent: Verify quadrature points cover the Fourier integration domain.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add a sampling coverage check after choosing integration points.

rewrite.before_summary: Sampled integration points feed integrand evaluation directly.
rewrite.after_summary: A domain-coverage check is inserted after sampling.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds evidence that the integration domain is adequately sampled.

operations.name: Analyze Integrand Smoothness
operations.intent: Flag rough Fourier integrands before option-pricing evaluation.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add an integrand smoothness check before evaluating the integral.

rewrite.before_summary: Integrand evaluation consumes sampled points directly.
rewrite.after_summary: A smoothness analysis is inserted before integrand evaluation.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds roughness evidence that can justify refinement or damping changes.

operations.name: Detect Singularity
operations.intent: Detect extreme integrand values after characteristic-function evaluation.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add a singularity check after evaluating the integrand.

rewrite.before_summary: Integrand values flow to error estimation directly.
rewrite.after_summary: A singularity detector is inserted after integrand evaluation.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds evidence for pathological integrand magnitude.

operations.name: Monitor Quadrature Convergence
operations.intent: Track slow convergence after option-pricing integration refinement.
operations.dejargonized_summary: Add a convergence-rate check after refinement.

rewrite.before_summary: Refined integral estimates flow downstream without convergence-rate evidence.
rewrite.after_summary: A convergence monitor is inserted after refinement.
rewrite.information_flow_effect: Adds evidence that refinement is reducing integration error.

audit.dejargonized_summary: These checks make integration pipelines report sample coverage, integrand roughness, singular values, and convergence.
